'''2008 Worlds Day 1 Robert J Johnson DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Robert J Johnson]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 1). Sheet title Sweeney Todd's BHBM.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Robert J Johnson]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)|Decipher + Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|Bring Him Before Me]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
